title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are thrilled to launch Spyglass, our sophisticated new tool that empowers you with comprehensive insights to effortlessly navigate and enhance your operations.

title: Empower Your Files with Enhanced Editor Controls
summary: Effortlessly manage your documents and images, upload new files directly, and customize their appearance with our new, intuitive editor controls.

title: Introducing the Noeko Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our brand-new product roadmap, where you can easily track recent updates, upcoming features, and future plans to stay informed on our progress.

title: Dynamic Checkboxes
summary: Our newly improved checkboxes are now bigger, more visually consistent, and easily draggable, making task organization more intuitive and efficient.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Work seamlessly with your team in the editor thanks to improved real-time updates and clear indicators that show who's actively contributing.

title: Elevated Sharing and Discovery
summary: Effortlessly discover and collaborate on shared items with new enhancements that ensure greater visibility and utility across the platform.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language with our new global language support, making our platform accessible to more users around the world.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source
summary: We are thrilled to open-source Noeko, inviting our community to collaborate, contribute, and shape the project's future with complete transparency and control.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Transform your knowledge exploration with an enhanced visual map, allowing you to quickly filter by tags and time, and easily see your shared connections.

title: Elevate Your Search: Introducing Dynamic Filters and Compendiums
summary: Introducing an enhanced search experience that empowers you to precisely filter and sort your knowledge, then save these tailored results as Compendiums for instant future reference.

title: Dynamic Content Display
summary: We are enhancing how you view and interact with linked content, offering flexible display modes to better structure your notes and reflect your thought process.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosted & Flexible Cloud Plans
summary: Soon, you can self-host Noeko on your own infrastructure or choose from our new flexible cloud plans, empowering you with greater control and access to advanced features.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Fresh Themes
summary: Discover a refreshed look for your favorite themes and explore a collection of stylish new options to customize your workspace.

title: Time-Perfect Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more personalized and delightful experience with homepage greetings that accurately reflect your local time, day or night.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items and perform actions like removing them directly from the tag view, boosting your productivity.

title: Unlock a World of Information with Expanded Source Support
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly import and interact with a variety of content types, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, empowering you to consolidate all your valuable information in one central hub.
